name: vectorcraft-bridge
description: Vectorize images, convert between SVG, PDF, AI, EPS, DXF, PNG and more, create and recolor vector designs with shapes, text, charts and effects, using the VectorCraft editor installed on Windows, macOS or Linux. Not affiliated with VectorCraft or Storytold.

vectorcraft_dir.title: VectorCraft folder
vectorcraft_dir.description: Install folder of VectorCraft (or VectorCraft.app on macOS). Leave empty to auto-detect: C:\Program Files\VectorCraft, /Applications/VectorCraft.app, /usr/bin, /opt/vectorcraft or PATH.

vectorcraft_cli.title: vectorcraft-cli executable (optional)
vectorcraft_cli.description: Only if it is somewhere else, e.g. where you unzipped vectorcraft-cli-<version>-macos-universal.zip on macOS.

control_port.title: VectorCraft control port (optional)
control_port.description: Port used to drive the VectorCraft app (run_vector_commands live). Default 7979.
